data.name: Karmaat
data.long_meaning: Karmaat is a name of Arabic origin meaning 'fruitful, generous'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'k-r-m', which means 'to generate, to yield', and is often used to describe someone who is abundant in blessings and goodness. In Islamic tradition, the name is also associated with the idea of sowing seeds of good deeds, which will bear fruit in the form of blessings and rewards in the hereafter.
